meta.name: Population 11
meta.description:
When American Andy pulls into a tiny Australian outback town to visit his father, he’s alarmed to discover that Hugo has vanished. He soon finds himself in increasing danger in a town full of secrets, where everyone is a suspect.

Complete series. On your server: S1 12/12

videos.title: Outback UFO Tours
videos.overview: A mysterious stranger arrives in the tiny outback town of Bidgeegud, searching for a local named Hugo, only to discover he is missing and that foul play might be involved in his disappearance.

videos.title: Stray Dogs
videos.overview: Newcomer Cassie begins helping Andy as he investigates Audrey, the local pie maker, who’s become the prime suspect in Hugo’s disappearance, only to discover Audrey is filling her pies with a mystery meat that she doesn’t want anyone to know about.

videos.title: Who's Jeff
videos.overview: After a narrow escape from Audrey, Andy sets his sight on Hugo’s nemesis, Noel, until the shocking truth about Hugo is revealed.

videos.title: Sweet 'N' Sour Dingo
videos.overview: As Andy and the town reel from the news about Hugo, Andy makes a shocking discovery that sets him on a collision course with Noel.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: After Andy is lured out to the desert by Cedric, and Cassie learns the shocking truth about Jimmy, Andy’s forced to come clean about his motives when he discovers Hugo’s secret hiding place.

videos.title: The Bunker
videos.overview: After Andy is betrayed by Cassie, he discovers Hugo’s secret bunker, only to come face to face with his killer.

videos.title: Earth Room
videos.overview: Cassie goes out on a limb to rescue Andy, only for him to lead them back into danger when they accept an invitation to stay at Trevor and Maureen’s, whose sinister motives are soon revealed.

videos.title: The Sea
videos.overview: While Andy battles Gareth for the money, Cassie makes an incriminating discovery at Leon’s house, only for Leon to catch her red-handed, causing her to realise that her life might be in danger.

videos.title: Trivia Night
videos.overview: As Andy grapples with what he’s done, Cassie inflames the ire of the town while hosting pub trivia, accusing several of murder, but all bets are off when the truth is turned completely on its head by Hugo.

videos.title: Like Father Like Son
videos.overview: Reunited with his long lost father, Andy finally confronts Hugo about the missing money, only for them to wind up lost in the bush, while Cassie witnesses the shocking discovery of Gareth’s body.

videos.title: Desert Pearls
videos.overview: Andy finally tracks down who stole the missing money, as Leon reveals his and Gareth’s true colours, and Geraldine takes extreme measures to control the situation.

videos.title: The Scorpion and the Frog
videos.overview: As the town reels from more homicide, Geraldine takes Cassie and Andy hostage, before Petey P shows up, forcing Andy to fight for his and Cassie’s survival.
